coursework.title: Systems & Backend Engineering
coursework.summary: The backbone of how I build reliable services — operating systems, networks, databases, and cloud-native web applications.
learnings: OS internals: process scheduling, virtual memory, concurrency, and synchronization
Networking: the TCP/IP stack, socket programming, HTTP, and routing
Databases: relational modeling, SQL, indexing, transactions, and normalization
Full-stack & cloud-native delivery: REST APIs, microservices, containerization, and deployment
Systems analysis & design: requirements engineering, UML modeling, and the software lifecycle

coursework.title: Algorithms & Programming Foundations
coursework.summary: Core computer-science foundations — data structures, algorithm design, programming paradigms, and cryptography.
learnings: Data structures (trees, graphs, heaps, hash tables) and asymptotic complexity analysis
Algorithm design: greedy, divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, and graph algorithms
Functional programming: immutability, higher-order functions, and recursion
Cryptography: symmetric/asymmetric encryption, hashing, and the number theory behind them

courses.name: Data Structures and Advanced Program Design

coursework.title: Machine Learning & Deep Learning
coursework.summary: From statistical learning theory to deep neural networks, and applying them to real industrial data.
learnings: Supervised & unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and regularization
Deep learning: CNNs, RNNs, backpropagation, and training/optimization
Statistical learning theory: the bias–variance tradeoff and ensemble methods
End-to-end ML pipelines in Python (scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow)
Domain application to manufacturing and industrial data

courses.name: Data Analysis and Machine Learning with Python

coursework.title: Data Science & Analytics
coursework.summary: Turning raw data into insight — analytics, information retrieval, visualization, and applied domain analytics.
learnings: Data wrangling, exploratory analysis, and statistical inference
Information retrieval and text mining / NLP fundamentals
Data visualization and data storytelling
Applied analytics for marketing, social media, and behavioral data

courses.name: Introduction to Information Retrieval and Text Mining
Data Visualization with Modern Data Science

coursework.title: Optimization & Decision Science
coursework.summary: Mathematical modeling for decision-making — optimization, game theory, and information economics.
learnings: Linear and integer programming and optimization modeling
Game theory, mechanism design, and information economics
Decision-making under uncertainty

coursework.title: Capstone & Team Projects
coursework.summary: Multi-semester, team-based software projects taking a product from requirements to delivery.
learnings: Full project lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, and delivery
Cross-functional teamwork and project management
3D and interactive media creation for the metaverse

courses.name: Introduction to 3D Creation for the Metaverse
